If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast peaks >+2.0% above recent high, reduce peak by 0.5–1.0% for mid-horizon (days 15–25).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast shows downward trend, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias in early horizon (days 1–10) to counteract pessimism.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is below recent low, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% in late horizon (days 26–30) to avoid underestimating rebound.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is above recent high, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% in late horizon to prevent over-optimism.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is above recent high, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% in mid-horizon to avoid overcorrection.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is below recent low, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% in early horizon to avoid underestimating recovery.
